title: ExplorerModuleCard
responsibility: Renders catalog and relationship cards with optional revision-scoped images and up to three flat Used In links.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.row
inputs.description: Selected module, helper identity, linked title and revision-scoped consumers.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.nav
inputs.description: Navigation preserving branch, commit, entity and selected helper.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.mediaBase
inputs.description: URL prefix for the selected evidence assets.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.shot
inputs.description: Optional own visual capture. Nonvisual modules omit the image region; missing visual captures remain explicit.

inputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard.category
inputs.description: Module category, defaulting to the row category. Visual and nonvisual cards share this renderer.

outputs.name: ExplorerModuleCard
outputs.description: One linked name or helper invocation, an optional visual capture, and one Used In footer with at most three distinct linked consumers; no consumer category labels.
